install_msg: You have just installed the 'redactor' cog. This cog auto-redacts messages with sensitive information and gives the author a temporary Discord review flow.
name: redactor
short: Auto-redacts likely secrets and lets the author review the action temporarily.
description: Auto-redacts messages with likely sensitive information, stores the original in memory briefly, and lets the author keep the redacted copy or restore the original through Discord buttons.
